name: Quant Backtest Lab · 量化回测台
tagline: An honest backtesting bench for trading ideas: fees in, verdict out
description: Describe a trading idea and it writes the rules out explicitly, then backtests them with transaction costs included across China A-shares, US equities and crypto spot. What returns is a verdict for the file: deploy, refine or kill. Output is Python scripts only; it places no orders and asks for no keys.
author: jackhu_bangzhu
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
